findings.description: The truck parked at the diner in the opening (00:00-00:10) is a white modern aerodynamic sleeper-cab semi tractor with a sloped hood and roof fairing and no visible box body. When the man leaves at 01:41, the truck he walks to and enters is a dark green classic long-nose conventional with twin chrome stacks and an attached straight box body with a white stripe. Make style, cab configuration (aero sleeper vs square long-nose day cab), body configuration (tractor vs box straight truck), and color all differ. This is not a lighting effect: the opening frames clearly show a light-colored aero body, and the later frames clearly show a squared hood and external stacks in good light. No swap is shown or implied, and there is no other truck in the scene.
